name: VIANA
description: Step into refined elegance with the Viana model, a spacious 2,978 square foot home featuring 4 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms designed for growing families. The open concept layout creates an airy, welcoming atmosphere where vaulted ceilings amplify natural light throughout. Entertain with ease in the expansive living area, where conversations flow naturally and memories are made. The gourmet kitchen serves as the perfect gathering place, featuring custom cabinets, granite countertops, and premium stainless-steel appliances. Every detail in the Viana reflects thoughtful design, creating a home that's both beautiful and perfectly functional for modern family living.
